title: Vex Hub Auto Win Bypass Obstacles Teleport More
features:
Auto Step Farm (Toggle): Jitters client-side to automatically farm step speed.
Auto Treadmill Farm (Toggle): Automatically teleports to and utilizes the nearest treadmill.
Auto Win Obby (Toggle): Teleports step-by-step through checkpoints to the finish line.
Walk Speed Value (Slider) + Lock Walk Speed (Toggle).
Jump Power Value (Slider) + Lock Jump Power (Toggle).
Bypass Obstacles (Godmode) (Toggle): Safely removes kill parts client-side.
Print Debug Info (F9) (Button): Dumps game objects & stats to the console.
Auto Rebirth (Toggle): Automatically triggers rebirth remotes.
Fly (WASD + Space/Ctrl) (Toggle): Fully fly through the obby.
Fly Speed (Slider).
Anti-Kick (Anti-AFK) (Toggle): Prevents idle disconnects for overnight farming.
Classic Humanoid Godmode (Button): Clones the Humanoid for state immortality.
